questions.text: Shruti is going to throw a ball from the top of a cliff. When she throws the ball from 80 feet above the ground, the function \(h(t)=-16{t}^{2}+64t+80\) models the height, h, of the ball above the ground as a function of time, t. Find: ⓐ the zeros of this function which tells us when the ball will hit the ground. ⓑ the time(s) the ball will be 80 feet above the ground. ⓒ the height the ball will be at \(t=2\) seconds which is when the ball will be at its highest point.
